body_lead: HYDERABAD: In a major transformation of the state's education system, chief minister A Revanth Reddy announced that Artificial Intelligence (AI) will be integrated into the school curriculum starting from the 2026-27 academic year. Reviewing the education department on Thursday, the CM, who also holds the education portfolio, directed officials to implement short-term AI training for teachers to help them adapt to the shifting technological landscape.
